import numpy as np
import pandas as pd

# Simulated image data: 5 images of 28x28 pixels (grayscale)
np.random.seed(42)
images = np.random.randint(0, 256, (5, 28, 28), dtype=np.uint8)

# Implement horizontal flip augmentation
flipped = np.array([np.fliplr(img) for img in images])

# Implement rotation by 90 degrees
rotated = np.array([np.rot90(img, k=1) for img in images])

# Implement brightness adjustment (multiply by factor)
brightness_factor = 1.3
brightened = np.clip(images.astype(float) * brightness_factor, 0, 255).astype(np.uint8)

# Print the original and augmented dataset shapes
print(f"Original images shape: {images.shape}")
print(f"Flipped images shape: {flipped.shape}")
print(f"Rotated images shape: {rotated.shape}")
print(f"Brightened images shape: {brightened.shape}")
print(f"\nTotal augmented dataset: {images.shape[0] * 4} images (original + 3 augmentations)")
print(f"Pixel value range - Original: [{images.min()}, {images.max()}]")
print(f"Pixel value range - Brightened: [{brightened.min()}, {brightened.max()}]")
